key_findings: Triptans act via Htr1b in A-fiber mechanonociceptors to produce analgesia in cold and SNI neuropathic pain models, with Htr1b-independent adverse effects.
Gi/o-coupled GPCRs in CGRP+ DRG neurons (Htr1b, Gpr19) are candidate analgesic targets.
